notes.title: Launch announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, wanderers![/h2]

[h2]«[i]The Passage of Time[/i]» will launch on steam soon - Be sure to add it to your wishlist!
We are super pumped to finally unveil our new game.
Join us on [url=https://twitter.com/tpotgame]Twitter[/url] to get weekly updates about our progress on the game!
You will get the opportunity to interact directly with the team!
We're looking forward to show more content and hope you'll enjoy the game.

The team of developers.[/h2]
